call_points.text: Sales volumes remained robust, driven by steady and resilient market demand across therapeutic segments.
R&D and API units are operational, and the new fermentation block is complete.
The wind-plus-solar hybrid power plant in Gujarat is being set up for captive consumption to reduce power costs and carbon footprint.

operating_notes.text: MicroBiopharm Japan reported revenues of JPY 7,827M (~₹470 Cr) in FY23, JPY 9,741M (~₹580 Cr) in FY24, JPY 9,312M (~₹560 Cr) in FY25, and estimated JPY 9.5B (~₹570 Cr) in FY26.
Signed definitive agreement to acquire 100% of MicroBiopharm Japan for ~₹1,300 Cr (JPY 21.5B) expected to close in Q2FY27.
Recommended final dividend of Re. 0.67 per share for FY26.
R&D spend in FY26 was approximately 9% of the topline.
Board approved raising up to ₹1,000 Cr via QIP and preferential issue to non-promoters.

timeline.summary: Shareholders via e-voting reappointed **Mrs. Kirandeep Madan (DIN: 00686547)** as Non-Executive Woman Independent Director on 2026-04-18 with 100% approval.
2026-04-23: Gujarat Themis Biosyn signs Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire Sanofi's portfolio of 13 anti-TB and anti-infective brands for €158 Mn
2026-05-19: Gujarat Themis incorporates wholly owned subsidiary Themis Biosyn Japan Limited
Entered definitive agreement to acquire 100% of MicroBiopharm Japan for ~₹1,300 Cr (JPY 21.5B) via Japanese subsidiary.
On May 22, 2026, Gujarat Themis Biosyn announced the signing of a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of MicroBiopharm Japan for ~₹1,300 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹44.23 Cr (+17.2% YoY), net profit ₹10.89 Cr (-9.2% YoY).
On May 25, 2026, Gujarat Themis Biosyn released its investor presentation for Q4 and FY26, highlighting a 17.2% YoY rise in quarterly revenue to ₹44.23 Cr and ongoing inorganic expansion plans.
2026-05-29: Gujarat Themis Biosyn incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Themis Biosyn Ireland Private Limited, with a share capital of 1,00,000 Euro.
Shareholders passed the special resolutions via e‑voting on 5 June 2026, with 99.14% votes in favour and 0% against.
Gujarat Themis Biosyn's board approved raising up to ₹1,000 Cr via QIP and a preferential issue to non-promoters on June 6, 2026.
